events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese, born in Weston-super-Mare, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us some of British comedy's most iconic moments.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as the 'White Album'.

angles.name: Album anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped the iconic 'White Album'. Which track from this double LP is your all-time favourite?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 years since his passing
events.blurb: Remembering Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who passed away on this day in 1991 at the age of 45. He would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Tribute to Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy continue to inspire. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', featuring classics like 'Norwegian Wood' and 'In My Life'.

angles.name: Album anniversary
angles.copy: Take a trip back to 1965! It's 61 years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album, but which track stands out for you?

events.title: John Lennon: 46 years since his passing
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and an iconic peace activist, who was tragically killed on this day in 1980. He would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Tribute to John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost a musical visionary and a voice for peace. Remembering John Lennon and his timeless legacy.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary David Bowie, born on this day in 1947, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday.

angles.name: Bowie tribute
angles.copy: The Starman would have been 80 today. Celebrating the incredible life and groundbreaking music of David Bowie. What's your favourite era of Bowie?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering 'The King of Rock & Roll', Elvis Presley, born on this day in 1935, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday.

angles.name: Elvis tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. Long live the King!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: English guitarist, songwriter, and producer Jimmy Page, best known as the founder of Led Zeppelin, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Guitar legend's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound, his riffs changed rock forever.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer-songwriter known for his distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rod the Mod's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to Sir Rod Stewart! From Faces to his incredible solo career, he's a true rock and roll icon. What's your favourite Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic lead singer of the iconic ska band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Madness frontman's birthday
angles.copy: It Must Be Love! Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs from Madness! What's your favourite track from the Nutty Boys?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer Paul Young, famous for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' and 'Every Time You Go Away', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Blue-eyed soul birthday
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! Still got that blue-eyed soul magic. What's your go-to Paul Young track?

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic singer-songwriter Dolly Parton, born on this day in 1946, who would have celebrated her 81st birthday. Dolly passed away on August 25, 2026.

angles.name: Dolly tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been her 81st birthday, we're celebrating the one and only Dolly Parton. A true legend whose music continues to shine.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter and lead vocalist of Take That, Gary Barlow, celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Take That frontman's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! What's your favourite song he's written?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of R&B and pop hits in the 70s and 80s, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen's birthday
angles.copy: Get Outta My Dreams, Get into My Car... and wish Billy Ocean a very happy 77th birthday! What's your favourite hit from the R&B legend?

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its first induction ceremony, honouring pioneers like Elvis Presley, Chuck Berry, and Little Richard.

angles.name: Rock Hall history
angles.copy: 38 years ago, rock history was made with the first-ever Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction! Who do you think should be inducted next?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Mark Owen, a member of the pop group Take That, celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Take That star's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! From Take That to his solo work, he's been a pop fixture for decades. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment?

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary impromptu rooftop concert on the Apple Corps building in London, their final public performance.

angles.name: Rooftop concert history
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert in London! Imagine being there!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: English singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins, known for his work with Genesis and a successful solo career, celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Music icon's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the incredible Phil Collins! From Genesis to his chart-topping solo career, he's a true musical powerhouse. What's your favourite Phil Collins track?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, actor, and record producer Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Pop Prince's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From NSYNC to solo stardom, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Sir David Jason, the beloved English actor known for iconic roles like Del Boy in 'Only Fools and Horses' and Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: National treasure's birthday
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! What's your favourite Del Boy moment?
